title: Plug-in solar panels still have safety risks in the UK despite legalisation | New Scientist
description: Plug-in solar panels offer reduced bills and can help boost renewable energy on Great Britain's grid, but concerns around their safety remain
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: Asteroid hit the moon and flung rocks 120 kilometres from the crater | New Scientist
description: Researchers have watched a huge crater form on the lunar surface, and its widespread effects could help inform future exploration of the moon and other similar places
author: Leah Crane

title: Earth is getting less dusty – which is both good and bad | New Scientist
description: The amount of dust in the atmosphere has fallen, which is good for our lungs, but is a loss for ecosystems that depend on wind-borne nutrients
author: James Woodford

title: T. rex teeth show the enormous predatory dinosaur was warm-blooded | New Scientist
description: Analysis of the chemistry of ancient T. rex tooth enamel adds weight to the idea that the fierce Cretaceous predator controlled its body temperature
author: James Woodford

title: Why it is time to restate the case for the importance of research on animals | New Scientist
description: Recent progress on alternatives to animal testing is hugely welcome. But talk of "phasing out" animal research completely is misleading and could even be dangerous to scientists
author: New Scientist

title: Satellite data gives clearer picture of how ice sheets are losing mass | New Scientist
description: The longest satellite record ever compiled shows the vast majority of ice loss from Greenland and Antarctica is due to glaciers flowing faster, rather than warmer air temperatures melting them at the surface
author: Alec Luhn
